selection_rule: Choose the mode that best proves the story beat. Do not show the tactical plate on every beat.

modes.purpose: Establish the episode question and stakes.
modes.preferred_visual: owner-approved exact-context match still or player portrait
modes.fallback: typographic question on an editorial colorway

modes.purpose: Show the exact passage being discussed.
modes.fallback: source card or explicitly illustrative tactical plate

modes.purpose: Explain a tactical structure or mechanism.
modes.preferred_visual: authored landscape pitch plate with context-aware team colors
modes.fallback: labeled diagram; no false match context

modes.purpose: Compare a compact set of sourced team or player metrics.
modes.preferred_visual: landscape statline card with direct value labels
modes.fallback: source card if values are missing

modes.purpose: Make the evidence trail visible when the argument depends on a source.
modes.preferred_visual: citation card with source, date, and claim
labeled horizontal bars with visible values and zero baseline
modes.fallback: source card if data is incomplete

modes.purpose: Show a sourced measure changing across ordered match moments or dates.
modes.fallback: source card if order or values are missing

modes.purpose: Return to Allen's bounded reading of the evidence.
modes.preferred_visual: quiet branded close or approved host media
modes.fallback: one-sentence takeaway and fixed channel signature

annotation_rules: Every annotation and value must be supported by reviewed evidence.
Library discoveries require owner choice before use.
Team colors are contextual; channel wordmark, typography, and identity neutrals stay stable.
Color must be paired with labels or direct values; do not use color alone to encode meaning.
No persistent subtitles or fabricated scorebug styling.
